title: Implement regulated workloads landing page + HubSpot form routing (UTMs, dedupe, Slack alerts)
creator: Ben Carter
project: Vertical ABM pilot: Regulated Workloads (FinServ + Healthcare)
description:
Background
- As part of the 6–8 week vertical ABM pilot (regulated workloads), we’re launching vertical landing pages (FinServ + Healthcare) with a high-intent CTA (“Schedule a security review” / “Request Private/VPC architecture walkthrough”).
- We need reliable attribution (UTMs), correct routing into HubSpot (owner assignment + lifecycle tagging), Slack notifications for speed-to-lead, and dedupe logic to avoid spammy alerts + duplicate contacts.

Scope
1) Landing page form submission capture
- Capture UTM parameters and key campaign context on submit.
- Normalize/referrer fields to avoid exceeding HubSpot property limits.
- Support both FinServ and Healthcare variants.

2) Routing rules (HubSpot + internal)
- Set HubSpot properties for:
  - ABM Pilot = true
  - Vertical = finserv | healthcare | unknown
  - Deployment interest = hosted | dedicated | private (default to private for regulated LP unless user selects otherwise)
  - Source = regulated_landing_page
  - Campaign identifiers from UTM_* + page path
- Assign lead owner based on vertical + region, with fallbacks:
  - NA FinServ -> Stephanie Nguyen queue / SDR routing
  - EMEA FinServ -> Lukas Meyer queue / SDR routing
  - NA Healthcare -> Stephanie Nguyen queue / SDR routing
  - EMEA Healthcare -> Lukas Meyer queue / SDR routing
  - Unknown region -> unassigned + notify #marketing for manual triage

3) Slack notifications
- Post to:
  - #marketing (all ABM LP submissions)
  - #sales (only when high-intent criteria met)
- High-intent criteria (initial):
  - form CTA = “Schedule security review” OR
  - deployment_interest = private OR
  - email domain is non-free (not gmail/yahoo/outlook) AND company size field >= mid-market
- Message must not include sensitive user-entered free text. Include:
  - name, company, title (if provided)
  - email (ok), work domain, vertical, region
  - deployment interest, CTA, page path
  - UTM summary
  - HubSpot record links (company/contact if available)

4) Dedupe logic
- Do not send duplicate Slack notifications for the same contact within 24 hours for the same page path + campaign.
- If contact already exists in HubSpot, associate submission to existing contact and update a “Last ABM Touch” property; do not create duplicates.
- If company exists, associate to existing company by domain; if ambiguous/no domain, do not attempt auto-company creation.

Non-goals (for pilot)
- Full multi-step form builder.
- Complex enrichment (Clearbit/ZoomInfo). Keep the pipeline lightweight and deterministic.

Open questions
- Confirm whether we want Slack alerts in #eng-security for “security review” CTA submissions (Aisha requested visibility but we should avoid noise). Proposed: notify only #marketing + #sales; Security can rely on HubSpot view + weekly rollup.
- Confirm required HubSpot properties and internal naming conventions per PM-482.

Acceptance criteria
- UTM capture: utm_source/medium/campaign/content/term + page_path are reliably persisted to HubSpot on every submit.
- Vertical is correctly inferred from page path when not explicitly selected.
- Slack alert fires within 60s of successful HubSpot ingest for >=95% of submissions.
- Dedupe: repeated submissions by same email do not create duplicate HubSpot contacts and do not spam Slack (24h window).
- Routing: owner assignment matches rules and is visible in HubSpot within 5 minutes.
- Privacy: Slack payload excludes any freeform message field; only whitelisted fields.

Implementation notes
- Use existing Redwood “lead intake” service endpoint; extend payload schema to include campaignContext + formType.
- Store a minimal submission fingerprint for dedupe: hash(email + page_path + utm_campaign + date_bucket).
- Any hard failures in HubSpot API should:
  - return 202 to client (do not block user)
  - enqueue retry (max 5 attempts)
  - alert #marketing-ops with error summary (no PII beyond email/domain)

Testing
- Unit tests: UTM parsing + vertical inference + routing rules.
- Integration test against HubSpot sandbox: create/update contact, association behavior, owner assignment.
- Manual QA checklist (pre-launch): verify Slack channels, verify dedupe window, verify HubSpot properties and links.

Rollout
- Feature flag: abm_form_routing_v1 (default off).
- Stage -> Prod rollout with a 24h observation period.
- Post-launch: Isabelle to validate attribution fields in the ABM metrics dashboard within 48h.
